pages.title: LLM Memory Architecture Survey
pages.content: RAG-based memory systems suffer from retrieval-rank collapse when context windows exceed 32k tokens. Active companion memory (Memanto model) outperforms passive vector stores by 40% on preference drift benchmarks. Key finding: contradiction resolution is the primary failure mode in production memory systems — flat vector stores return stale facts when newer contradicting facts share high semantic similarity with the query.

pages.title: Switch primary memory backend from Pinecone to Memanto
pages.content: Decided to migrate the agent memory layer from Pinecone to Memanto. Rationale: Pinecone returns stale preference data in 3/5 contradiction test cases. Memanto's active recall scored 85.6% accuracy vs 54.1% for Mem0. Migration path: export Pinecone vectors -> Memanto batch_remember API. Estimated savings: 65% fewer tokens retrieved per query, 4.8x lower p95 recall latency.

pages.title: User prefers concise API responses under 500ms
pages.content: User explicitly stated preference for API responses under 500ms p95. Tolerates up to 1s for complex recall operations but considers anything above 2s a UX failure. Prefers streaming for long outputs over waiting for complete response. Dislikes verbose error messages.

pages.title: Q3 planning: memory system roadmap
pages.content: Q3 planning session. Agreed to prioritize: (1) temporal recall API, (2) contradiction detection pipeline, (3) multi-agent namespace isolation. Mitchell owns temporal recall. Deadline: end of Q3. Budget approved for Moorcheh infrastructure scaling to 10k req/min.

pages.title: LoCoMo: Long-Conversation Memory Benchmark
pages.content: LoCoMo is a long-conversation dataset for evaluating memory systems. Contains 50-turn conversations with ground-truth annotations. Used in Memanto vs Mem0 benchmark: Memanto scored R@20=83.3% vs Mem0 63.3%. Dataset is freely available via HuggingFace.

pages.title: Adopt UTC-aware datetimes throughout memory write pipeline
pages.content: Decision: replace all datetime.utcnow() calls with datetime.now(timezone.utc) in memory_write_service.py and core.py (12 locations). Root cause: naive timestamps written to storage, timezone-aware timestamps used in temporal filters — silent TypeError causing temporal filters to fail open.

pages.title: Agent committed to shipping temporal recall by end of Q3
pages.content: Mitchell committed to delivering the temporal recall endpoints (recall/as-of, recall/changed-since) by October 31, 2025. Commitment made during Q3 planning meeting. Budget approved. This is a blocker for the Moorcheh v0.2.x release.

pages.title: Observation: LLM judge variance increases above temperature 0.1
pages.content: Observed significant score variance in LLM-as-judge eval runs when temperature > 0.1. At temperature=0.0, GPT-4o-mini with seed=42 produces deterministic scores. Recommendation: always pin temperature=0.0 and document judge model and version in benchmark methodology.

pages.title: Goal: win Memanto bug bounty with 3+ Critical/High severity bugs
pages.content: Goal: submit PR #784 with at minimum 3 reproducible High-severity bugs in Memanto's temporal recall pipeline. Found bugs: (1) naive/aware datetime mismatch in 12 locations, (2) recall/as-of has no query field causing timeline amnesia, (3) 100-memory silent cap in _fetch_all_memories. All submitted with reproducible failing tests and actual fixes.
